test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What significant step did the Karnataka High Court emphasise in November 2025 regarding child safety equipment?

options.text: Limited exemption of child helmet use in rural Karnataka areas
Promotion of local manufacturing of child safety gear in Karnataka
Delayed relaxation of child safety regulations until further notice
Immediate implementation and enforcement of child helmet safety rules in Karnataka

solution:
The correct answer is __**Immediate implementation and enforcement of child helmet safety rules in Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a significant judicial move in **November 2025**, the **Karnataka High Court** took a stern stance on the safety of young commuters, emphasizing the **immediate implementation and enforcement** of child helmet safety rules across the state.
 
• The Court observed that despite the existence of central guidelines, there has been a lack of rigorous execution by the state authorities, leading to increased vulnerability of children on **two-wheelers**.
 
• The directive specifically mandates that the **Transport Department** and **Traffic Police** in **Karnataka** must ensure every child above a certain age wears a **protective headgear** (helmet) that fits them properly and meets safety standards.
